nodes.name: TNF superfamily member 11 (RANKL)
cleavage_sites: TACE / ADAM17 cleavage site (aa 145-146 shedding soluble RANKL)

known_targeting_drugs: Denosumab (FDA Approved human monoclonal antibody; specifically binds and neutralizes RANKL, preventing RANK receptor engagement)

novel_crosstalk: Mechanotransduction & Cytoskeletal Tension (TNFSF11 cooperates with integrin focal adhesion complexes under mechanical strain)

Tumor Immunosuppression (TREM2+ TAMs suppress CD8+ T cell infiltration via immunosuppressive ligand expression)

nodes.quaternary_structure: Homodimer (catalytically active kinase/phosphatase bifunctional enzyme with 700:1 kinase ratio)
ptm_residues: Ser461 (phosphorylated by AMPK / MK2 markedly activating 2-kinase activity)
nodes.activation_state: Ser461 phosphorylated (hyperactive glycolytic driver producing Fru-2,6-P2 to allosterically activate PFKM)
known_targeting_drugs: PFK-15 (Selective PFKFB3 small-molecule inhibitor; suppresses fructose-2,6-bisphosphate synthesis and curtails glycolytic flux)
AZ67 (PFKFB3 inhibitor; tested in inflammatory osteolysis)

pan_disease.oncology: Clear cell renal cell carcinoma, glioblastoma, triple-negative breast cancer, hepatocellular carcinoma (drives Warburg glycolysis surge)
pan_disease.autoimmune_inflammatory: Rheumatoid arthritis (drives T-cell and synovial fibroblast hyper-glycolysis), pulmonary arterial hypertension, inflammatory bowel disease
pan_disease.cardiovascular_metabolic: Atherosclerotic plaque intraplaque angiogenesis (endothelial tip cell hyper-glycolysis), cardiac ischemic injury
pan_disease.neurodegenerative: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) astrocytic metabolic failure; microglial glycolytic shift during neuroinflammation

novel_crosstalk: Angiogenic Endothelial Tip vs Stalk Cell Competition (PFKFB3 drives filopodia formation and glycolytic ATP for cytoskeletal remodeling in sprouting vessels)
Ferroptosis Sensitivity (Hyper-glycolysis driven by PFKFB3 alters cellular lipid peroxidation and NADPH consumption)
Autophagy-Glycolysis Interlock (AMPK phosphorylates PFKFB3 Ser461 while PFKFB3-derived F-2,6-BP regulates nuclear gene transcription)

proteomics.tissue_breadth: Ubiquitous with intense induction in proliferating, transformed, or hypoxia-exposed tissues
proteomics.hpa_subcellular: Cytoplasm (glycolytic complexes), Nucleus (co-localizes with cyclin-dependent kinases)

nodes.name: Aconitate decarboxylase 1 (IRG1)

pan_disease.oncology: Glioblastoma stemness, peritoneal metastatic ovarian cancer (promotes immune evasion and macrophage M2-like shift)
pan_disease.autoimmune_inflammatory: Septic shock, severe COVID-19 cytokine storm, rheumatoid arthritis, gouty inflammation (ACOD1 serves as an emergency anti-inflammatory negative feedback brake)
pan_disease.cardiovascular_metabolic: Diabetic cardiomyopathy, ischemia-reperfusion injury, non-alcoholic steatohepatitis (MASH)
pan_disease.neurodegenerative: Neuroinflammation following traumatic brain injury and ischemic stroke; suppresses microglial neurotoxicity

novel_crosstalk: Endogenous Anti-Oxidant Defense (Itaconate generated by ACOD1 alkylates KEAP1 cysteine residues C151/C273/C288, unleashing Nrf2 transcriptional antioxidant cascade)
Inflammasome Quenching (Itaconate dicarboxymethylates NLRP3 at Cys548 preventing inflammasome oligomerization and IL-1beta maturation)
TCA Cycle Cataplerosis & SDH Inhibition (Itaconate acts as a competitive substrate inhibitor of Complex II / Succinate Dehydrogenase)

proteomics.gtex_top_tissue: Induced >1000-fold in LPS/IFN-gamma-activated Monocytes & Macrophages (Baseline: 0.8 TPM -> Stimulated: 840.5 TPM)
proteomics.tissue_breadth: Myeloid restricted (Monocytes, Macrophages, Dendritic cells, Microglia)
proteomics.hpa_subcellular: Mitochondrial matrix (physically associated with TCA cycle multi-enzyme metabolon)

mutations.clinvar_pathogenic: VCV000912450 (p.Gly185Arg, inactivates decarboxylase catalytic cleft)
mutations.cosmic_hotspots: COSV69120481 (p.Arg312Trp, glioblastoma)

flux_kinetics.rate_limiting: Yes (Sole committed metabolic producer of immunometabolite itaconate from cis-aconitate)
flux_kinetics.allosteric_regulators: Activators: TLR4/MyD88 and IFN-beta/STAT1 transcriptional transactivation; Inhibitors: MicroRNA miR-146a, feedback succinate accumulation
flux_kinetics.flux_directionality: Irreversible decarboxylation of cis-aconitate -> itaconate + CO2

pan_literature.title: Immune-responsive gene 1 protein links metabolism to macrophage antimicrobial activity by producing itaconic acid.
Itaconate is an anti-inflammatory metabolite that activates Nrf2 via alkylation of KEAP1.
Itaconate confers tolerance to metabolic stress through competitive inhibition of succinate dehydrogenase.

cleavage_sites: Autocatalytic cleavage of propeptide at acidic pH (cleaves after aa 114 to generate active 215-aa protease)
nodes.activation_state: Inactive zymogen in vesicles; autocatalytically processed to mature active protease at pH < 5.0 in resorption pit
nodes.kinase_substrates: None (protease cleaves triple-helical Type I and Type II collagen)
known_targeting_drugs: Odanacatib (Phase 3 selective CTSK inhibitor)
Balicatib (Phase 2 CTSK inhibitor)
Relacatib (Preclinical CTSK inhibitor)

pan_disease.oncology: Breast and prostate cancer bone metastases (degrades osteoid organic collagen matrix ahead of tumor seeding), melanoma invasion, lung adenocarcinoma
pan_disease.autoimmune_inflammatory: Rheumatoid arthritis (synovial fluid CTSK drives cartilage erosion), systemic sclerosis / scleroderma, psoriatic arthritis
pan_disease.cardiovascular_metabolic: Atherosclerosis (CTSK cleaves elastin and collagen in fibrous caps, driving plaque rupture), abdominal aortic aneurysm, obesity-associated adipose fibrosis
pan_disease.neurodegenerative: Age-related neuroinflammation; lysosomal processing in activated microglia
pan_disease.rare_genetic_omIM: OMIM:601105 (Pycnodysostosis; autosomal recessive dense bone dysplasia, short stature, acroosteolysis, Toulouse-Lautrec syndrome)

novel_crosstalk: Extracellular Matrix Remodeling in Fibrosis (CTSK degrades native triple-helical Type I, II, and XI collagen and insoluble elastin at neutral-to-acidic pH)
Adipogenesis & Energy Expenditure (CTSK-deficient mice are protected from high-fat diet-induced obesity through altered uncoupling protein UCP1 signaling)
Elastolysis in Vascular Aneurysms (Cleaves arterial elastin lamellae triggering fatal thoracic and abdominal dissections)

proteomics.gtex_top_tissue: Bone Marrow (82.1 TPM), Spleen (28.4 TPM), Lung (18.6 TPM), Adipose Tissue (14.2 TPM)
proteomics.tissue_breadth: Osteoclast and macrophage lineage enriched; present in synovial fibroblasts and thyroid
proteomics.hpa_subcellular: Lysosomes, secretory vesicles, extracellular resorption pit / Howship's lacuna

mutations.clinvar_pathogenic: VCV000004163 (p.Arg241Ter, null zymogen causing pycnodysostosis); VCV000004164 (p.Gly146Arg, catalytic cleft distortion)
mutations.cosmic_hotspots: COSV68412903 (p.Ala277Val, prostate adenocarcinoma bone metastasis)

flux_kinetics.rate_limiting: Yes (Rate-limiting endopeptidase for complete cleavage of telopeptide and triple-helical osteoid collagen)
flux_kinetics.allosteric_regulators: Activators: Chondroitin 4-sulfate (forms high-molecular-weight tetramers with 4-fold enhanced collagenase activity); Inhibitors: Cystatin C, Cys139-targeting nitrile inhibitors
flux_kinetics.flux_directionality: Irreversible hydrolytic cleavage of triple-helical Type I/II collagen into crosslinked telopeptide fragments

pan_literature.title: Defective cathepsin K in patients with pycnodysostosis, an autosomal recessive osteochondrodysplasia.
Cathepsin K deficiency prevents atherosclerotic lesion progression and promotes plaque stability.
Odanacatib for the treatment of postmenopausal osteoporosis: results of the Phase 3 LOFT trial.

nodes.name: Hypoxia inducible factor 1 subunit alpha (HIF1a)

pan_disease.oncology: Clear cell renal cell carcinoma (VHL loss leads to constitutive HIF1A), glioblastoma, pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (drives Warburg glycolysis, angiogenesis, and EMT)
pan_disease.autoimmune_inflammatory: Rheumatoid arthritis synovial hypoxia, inflammatory bowel disease epithelial barrier maintenance
pan_disease.cardiovascular_metabolic: Coronary artery disease, peripheral arterial disease, myocardial infarction (HIF-1alpha orchestrates ischemic preconditioning)
pan_disease.neurodegenerative: Cerebral ischemia / stroke penumbra neuroprotection; vascular cognitive impairment
pan_disease.rare_genetic_omIM: OMIM:603348 (Hypoxia-inducible factor 1, alpha subunit); Master regulator of cellular adaptation to hypoxia

novel_crosstalk: Hypoxic Glycolytic Coupling (Transactivates HK2, PFKFB3, LDHA, and PDK1 to shut down pyruvate dehydrogenase and direct flux to lactate)
Angiogenic Vessel Sprouting (Directly transactivates VEGF-A, Angiopoietin-2, and PDGF-B in response to pO2 < 5%)
Oxygen-Independent Pseudohypoxia (TCA cycle metabolites fumarate and succinate inhibit EGLN/PHD prolyl hydroxylases stabilizing HIF-1alpha)

proteomics.gtex_top_tissue: Kidney (38.2 TPM), Lung (35.4 TPM), Heart (31.0 TPM), Spleen (28.7 TPM)
proteomics.tissue_breadth: Ubiquitous (Ubiquitously transcribed; post-translationally regulated by oxygen availability)
proteomics.hpa_subcellular: Cytosol (normoxia, rapid proteasomal clearance) <-> Nucleus (hypoxia, heterodimer with ARNT/HIF-1beta)

mutations.clinvar_pathogenic: VCV000142890 (p.Pro564Ala, prevents VHL-mediated ubiquitination leading to normoxic pseudohypoxia)
mutations.cosmic_hotspots: COSV54891024 (p.Pro402Ser, disrupts prolyl hydroxylation in ccRCC)

flux_kinetics.rate_limiting: Yes (Master molecular sensor and rate-limiting transactivator for cellular hypoxia adaptation)
flux_kinetics.allosteric_regulators: Activators: Hypoxia (pO2 < 2%), succinate, fumarate, cobalt chloride; Inhibitors: Oxygen + 2-oxoglutarate (triggers EGLN prolyl hydroxylation and pVHL E3 ligase degradation)
flux_kinetics.flux_directionality: Normoxic half-life is <5 minutes; hypoxia stabilizes heterodimerization with ARNT at 5'-RCGTG-3' hypoxia response elements

evidence.quote_or_description: RANKL binds RANK to recruit TRAF6 triggering downstream signaling in BMMs. [Confirmed by STRING v12.0 mouse PPI: score=0.999, escore=0.977]
TRAF6 recruitment to cytoplasmic tail of RANK is indispensable for osteoclastogenesis. [Confirmed by STRING v12.0 mouse PPI: score=0.988, escore=0.727]
Canonical signaling transduction step: HGNC:TRAF6 activates HGNC:IKBKB reported in PMID:16339965. [Confirmed by STRING v12.0 mouse PPI: score=0.999, escore=0.26]
IKK complex activation phosphorylates IkB leading to p50/p65 NF-kB nuclear entry. [Confirmed by STRING v12.0 mouse PPI: score=0.997, escore=0.659]

Canonical signaling transduction step: HGNC:TRAF6 activates HGNC:MAPK8 reported in PMID:16339965. [Confirmed by STRING v12.0 mouse PPI: score=0.961, escore=0.089]
Canonical signaling transduction step: HGNC:MAPK8 activates HGNC:FOS reported in PMID:16339965. [Confirmed by STRING v12.0 mouse PPI: score=0.983, escore=0.264]
c-Fos cooperation with NFATc1 drives high-level auto-amplification of NFATc1 in BMMs. [Confirmed by STRING v12.0 mouse PPI: score=0.904, escore=0.132]
Canonical signaling transduction step: HGNC:SPI1 activates HGNC:NFATC1 reported in PMID:16339965. [Confirmed by STRING v12.0 mouse PPI: score=0.743, escore=0]
Canonical signaling transduction step: HGNC:TYROBP activates HGNC:SYK reported in PMID:16339965. [Confirmed by STRING v12.0 mouse PPI: score=0.999, escore=0.736]

Canonical signaling transduction step: HGNC:SYK activates HGNC:PLCG2 reported in PMID:16339965. [Confirmed by STRING v12.0 mouse PPI: score=0.999, escore=0.556]
Canonical signaling transduction step: HGNC:BTK activates HGNC:PLCG2 reported in PMID:16339965. [Confirmed by STRING v12.0 mouse PPI: score=0.999, escore=0.168]
PLCgamma2 activation downstream of ITAM phosphorylation triggers sustained intracellular Ca2+ oscillations. [Confirmed by STRING v12.0 mouse PPI: score=0.911, escore=0.06]
Calcineurin phosphatase dephosphorylates NFATc1 leading to nuclear import and auto-induction. [Confirmed by STRING v12.0 mouse PPI: score=0.994, escore=0.831]
RANKL-induced NFATc1 directly promotes the transcription of key glycolytic enzymes including HK2.

Biochemical reaction catalyzed by HGNC:GPI generating CHEBI:15946 per RHEA entry RHEA:11824.
PFKFB3 produces fructose-2,6-bisphosphate allosterically activating PFKM and accelerating glycolytic flux. [Confirmed by STRING v12.0 mouse PPI: score=0.964, escore=0.052]

Biochemical reaction catalyzed by HGNC:LDHA generating CHEBI:16651 per RHEA entry RHEA:16653.
Lactate generation maintains NAD+ regeneration necessary to sustain prolonged osteoclast survival.
Coupled transamination by PSAT1 utilizing PHGDH-derived phosphohydroxypyruvate fuels net alpha-KG production.
Intracellular alpha-KG serves as an indispensable co-substrate for 2-oxoglutarate-dependent histone demethylases.
KDM6B demethylates repressive H3K27me3 marks at the Nfatc1 promoter allowing transcription.
Canonical signaling transduction step: CHREV:H3K27me3_demethylation_Nfatc1 activates HGNC:NFATC1 reported in PMID:38200114.
PRMT6 directly catalyzes asymmetric dimethylation of H3R2 at the promoters of fatty acid oxidation genes.
Enriched H3R2me2a marks recruit transcriptional repressors leading to downregulation of Ppard and Cpt1a.
Re-expression of PPARd restored FAO and blunted osteoclast differentiation.
Biochemical reaction catalyzed by HGNC:GLS generating CHEBI:16015 per RHEA entry RHEA:15449.
Biochemical reaction catalyzed by CHEBI:16015 generating CHEBI:30915 per REACTOME entry R-HSA-70635.
Glutaminolysis maintains nucleotide pools and TCA intermediates required for osteoclast maturation.
Itaconate directly blocks the catalytic activity of TET2 dioxygenase.
TET2 mediates 5hmC deposition at pro-osteoclastogenic enhancer elements.
TET2 knockdown severely compromises terminal osteoclast differentiation.
alpha_v_beta_3 integrin engagement induces c-Src activation at the podosome belt. [Confirmed by STRING v12.0 mouse PPI: score=0.966, escore=0.078]
